description: The notice board (Features WV2, P6.core; catalog world-notice-board): which notices a settlement's board shows and in what order, unread counts, and what reading, answering and taking a quest raise; plus NoticeGenerator's articles. Ops: board {notices, fluency?, read?, answered?, questStatus?, steps?: [{op: select | answer (index) | take_quest, id}]} -> {initial, steps: [{result, view}]}; generate {settlementId, settlementName, npcs} -> {articles} (each trimmed to its ids, titles, type, difficulty, XP, author, quest hook, vocabulary count and whether it asks a question). Every case is {name, op, input, expected}; numbers compare within tolerance, everything else exactly, object key sets included (a key TypeScript leaves undefined is absent). Runner: src/props/props-corpus.ts. Regenerate with npm run props-corpora; npm run props-corpora:check fails on any difference.
sources: babylon origin/main bfcdeb2: packages/babylon/src/engine/game-engine/rendering/BabylonNoticeBoardPanel.ts (562 lines): assessment first, fluency thresholds 25 and 55, newest first, read on first view, one answer per notice, the Accept Quest button.
godot origin/main 6599874: addons/insimul/ui/notice_board_panel.gd (135 lines): no id is not posted, the unread count, an unknown id is refused.
core game-engine/logic/NoticeGenerator.ts generateSettlementNotices (deterministic: one per NPC by occupation).

contract.order: assessment notices (assessmentHook) in posted order, then every other shown notice in posted order reversed (newest first)
contract.shown: an assessment notice always; otherwise fluency (absent or non-finite is 0) >= the difficulty's threshold; a difficulty outside the table always
contract.posting: a notice with no id is not posted; a second with a posted id is ignored
contract.hookState: from questStatus[questId]: active taken, completed done, unavailable locked, anything else or none offer; an offer this board has already raised quest_requested for reads requested (once per quest per board, every notice hooking that quest), until the host builds the board again with the new status
refusalOrder: then the action's own: answer no_question, answered, bad_index; take_quest no_quest, quest_not_offered
contract.select: selects it; the first read raises notice_read then reading_xp when readingXp > 0; a notice read before raises nothing
contract.takeQuest: while offer: quest_requested {quest, npc: the author's characterId or null}; the host then sends the quest lifecycle's offer {quest, npc} and accept {quest}

cases.name: board: assessment notices first in posted order, then the rest newest first, filtered by fluency 0
board: a difficulty outside the table is always shown
board: a notice with no id is not posted, a second with a posted id is ignored
board: reading marks read once, grants its reading XP once, and the unread count falls
board: a notice read before raises nothing
board: a question is answered once; a bad index is refused
board: a question answered before is not asked
board: a quest hook is offered while its quest is available, naming the author as giver
board: a hook whose quest has no status is offered, with no giver when the notice has no author
board: a hook raises quest_requested once; then it reads requested and a second take is refused, on every notice hooking that quest
board: a hook is taken while active, done once completed, locked while unavailable
board: refusals: unknown action, unknown notice, a notice the fluency hides, no quest
generate: one notice per NPC by occupation, ids by settlement and index, XP by difficulty
